confirmed_examples.source: That's exactly what we need: more dead bodies.

confirmed_examples.source: It needs a coffin, not a knife.

identity: Normally I would tend to the wounded and do medical research, but with our relative safety and limited free time I mostly sell medical supplies these days.  I'm also the cook because nobody else here is good at cooking.  I would be surprised if one of them prepared an edible lung confit, let alone one that tastes good.

identity: This one can't be saved, too much brain rotten.  But I can salvage bits from them or repurpose them into a walker, or just cut out the rot and neural interface so you can bury them proper.

identity: &Rubik stares at Venn, and after a long silence, they offer each other a stiff bow.  Rubik places a hand upon your shoulder.  It's a familiar, warm gesture.  A stark juxtaposition to the chill of their metal hand.  You lay back upon the table, and you hear a mechanical whirr as the spider-like surgical robot starts to greedily tap away at your extremities.  You barely have a moment to consider your actions before it all goes black…
